newsitem.title: USA: Cinergi okays library sale to Disney - report.
newsitem.headline: Cinergi okays library sale to Disney - report.

text.p: NEW YORK (Variety) - Cinergi Pictures Entertainment's board approved the sale of its film library to Walt Disney Co, Daily Variety said on Thursday.
Disney would buy the library, except for the film Die Hard With a Vengeance, in exchange for the cancellation of $38 million in production advances Disney made Cinergi, Variety said, citing sources.
Disney's distribution deal with Cinergi, with 16 out of 25 pictures outstanding, would also be canceled, the report said.
